name: Eleanor Murray Fallon Middle School
bell_schedule:
Monday / Tuesday / Thursday / Friday:
  Zero Period: 7:40 AM – 8:30 AM
  Period 1:  8:35 AM – 9:27 AM
  Period 2:  9:31 AM – 10:21 AM
  Nutrition Break: 10:21 AM – 10:29 AM
  Period 3:  10:29 AM – 11:19 AM
  Lunch / Period 4 block: 11:19 AM – 12:48 PM
    Period 4 (6th grade and 7B): 11:23 AM – 12:13 PM
    Lunch A (7A and 8th grade):  11:19 AM – 11:54 AM
    Period 4 (7A and 8th grade): 11:58 AM – 12:48 PM
    Lunch B (6th grade and 7B):  12:13 PM – 12:48 PM
  Period 5:  12:52 PM – 1:42 PM
  Advisory/Academic Prep: 1:46 PM – 2:11 PM
  Period 6:  2:15 PM – 3:05 PM

Wednesday:
  Zero Period: 7:45 AM – 8:30 AM
  Period 1:  8:35 AM – 9:22 AM
  Period 2:  9:26 AM – 10:11 AM
  Period 3:  10:15 AM – 11:00 AM
  Lunch / Period 4 block: 11:00 AM – 12:22 PM
    Period 4 (6th grade and 7B): 11:04 AM – 11:49 AM
    Lunch A (7A and 8th grade):  11:00 AM – 11:33 AM
    Period 4 (7A and 8th grade): 11:37 AM – 12:22 PM
    Lunch B (6th grade and 7B):  11:49 AM – 12:22 PM
  Period 5:  12:26 PM – 1:11 PM
  Period 6:  1:15 PM – 2:00 PM

Minimum Days:
  Zero Period: 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM
  Period 1:  8:35 AM – 9:07 AM
  Period 2:  9:11 AM – 9:41 AM
  Period 3:  9:45 AM – 10:15 AM
  Nutrition Break: 10:15 AM – 10:22 AM
  Period 4:  10:22 AM – 10:52 AM
  Period 5:  10:56 AM – 11:26 AM
  Period 6:  11:30 AM – 12:00 PM
  Grab-and-go lunch can be picked up in the MPR at the end of a minimum day.

Lunch and Period 4 are split by grade: 6th grade and 7B take Period 4 first
then Lunch B, while 7A and 8th grade take Lunch A first then Period 4.
